## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Niagara Falls, Canada. It starts at 4983 Clifton Hill.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> With over 20 themed installations bursting with color and excitement, Ripley's Selfie Studios is the perfect place to capture those unforgettable moments.
>
> Ripley's Selfie Studios invites you to unleash your creativity. Whether you're a content creator, a family looking to make memories, or simply seeking a unique adventure, there's something there for everyone.
>
> Get ready for endless photo and video opportunities as you explore ingeniously designed scenes.
>
> From balancing on a tightrope over Niagara Falls to lounging in style or posing against vibrant graffiti walls, the possibilities for fun and creativity are endless.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.09. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 1 ratings and 1 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
